phase3_findings.description: The new 'superset of the four always-on reviewers' Step-1 floor contradicts the iterations:first-only exclusion (phase-3-agents.md), which legitimately drops an always-on agent from the fix loop's iter>=2 roster; a correct sub-floor report would be spuriously flagged malformed and fall back to inline.

Defense-in-depth: the rewrite dropped the has_new_types->type-design-analyzer diff_profile cross-check that remained evaluable, leaving a narrow self-consistent-under-fan path for type-design-analyzer.

fix_decisions.claim_text: re-add a has_new_types->type-design-analyzer diff_profile cross-check as defense-in-depth
fix_decisions.evidence: reintroduces the diff_profile roster coupling the change deliberately removed for a uniform engine-reported operand; the engine roster is authoritative by design and the gated-in-but-not-dispatched under-fan is already caught by phase3_dispatched-covers-expected_reviewers; a per-reviewer diff_profile cross-check is a partial patch (pr-test-analyzer stays uncoverable) working against issue AC1/AC2's single-operand intent
